section: Brain Power: Sigils, and the Sigilist
prompt:
Create an original Project Heaven Cry illustration in HEAVENPRINT. Use the attached approved Original 27 and New Faces
images as the painting authority: expressive ink and opaque gouache, deliberate angular form, selective dry-brush
scumbling, restrained hatching, charcoal lost edges and warm ivory accents. Faces have believable anatomy and restrained
stylization and specific emotional acting. Format: 4:5, 800 x 1000 PNG, one character from the chest or waist up, one
visible action, one specific emotion, one useful setting hint behind them; the eye line about 22% from the top. The class
attribute's pigment appears only as one accent (given in the section). No text, frame, UI or watermark; no real-world
person, brand or recognisable character. The portrait shows:

Paint: A thin, precise caster in a work coat with an Evoker glove raised, a line of light-glyphs drawn on the floor behind, face calm and counting.
Avoid: a wizard robe and hat · any letters in the glyphs
CAST AND STAGING: A thin 60-year-old man with warm brown skin, an angular lined face, close-cropped silver hair, dark narrow eyes and a clean-shaven chin. Waist-up slight right profile, eyes track his RAISED EVOKER GLOVE at upper chest level. Practical charcoal work coat, no armor, wizard robe or hat. Glove is intelligible brass/ceramic mechanical finger frame with one round mana core on back, correctly attached to wrist. A LINE OF THREE ABSTRACT GEOMETRIC GLYPHS lies on floor receding behind his lower side, only diamond/hexagon/wedge marks, no letters or real script. One pale workshop window is the useful background hint. Eye line22%, actual hand and restrained glyph construction clear. Avoid generic magic orb and reference identity.
ACTING SENTENCE: A precise caster holds the Evoker glove steady while a measured command line settles behind him, and feels calm concentration.
Rendering follows the approved paintings: visible deliberate angular opaque gouache brush blocks, broken ink contours, selective dry scumbling, quiet charcoal lost edges and warm ivory focal planes. Believable face anatomy with restrained illustration stylization, no photo skin/3D gloss/airbrush, no oversized anime eyes. Borrow rendering, NEVER the identity/face/pose/costume of a reference person. The final small motif reference supplies only the class's equipment/gesture motif; DO NOT paste its emblem/frame into painting. Vertical 4:5, full-bleed opaque RGB painting, chest/waist-up, eye line approximately22% from top, face/decisive hands/tool central80%. One person, action, emotion, useful setting hint. Preserve natural skin/cloth/metal colors; one icy-cyan #8BDEEE glove-and-glyph light accent is the SINGLE ATTRIBUTE ACCENT, never a monochrome wash. No letters, readable glyphs, labels, symbols of real faiths, real insignia, caption, UI, frame, border or watermark.
